champions.scope: Tall narrow crescent profile; chain does not contribute to idle lateral radius; jacket is above the feet.
Vertical fan and chest-level bell; skirt hem stays above feet and does not spread into adjacent figures.
Claw carried along forward lane axis; attack arc is local and not an oversized horizontal disk.
Longitudinal footprint with close-set feet; tail bends along the body axis instead of sweeping lateral lanes.
Quills are tall rather than wide; needle remains upright outside attack and no infinite line trails.
Wide low head but short limbs; bowl is front-centered and reed staff is vertical, not a large lateral branch.
Crescent ears grow vertically; folded fins and a short tail stay within the resting shoulder envelope.
Long spear aligns with lane axis; no broad flag; crest is thin and vertical.
Blades describe compact forearm arcs; no world-yaw spinning or wide skirt.
Large prop stays vertical in rest and follows a short overhead arc; body remains narrow.
Lantern stays within torso/front volume; collar is narrow, coat hem stays above ankles.
Prism and cape are diagonal but close; beam is flat along the BattleLine rather than a screen-filling shaft.
Additional feet tuck under the narrow thorax; blade is diagonal-forward rather than sideways.
Abdomen is mostly longitudinal; no wide wing opening, explosion visuals never push crowd members.
Wing planes kept nearly vertical, folded rearward; aim line and projectile stay narrow.
Round abdomen is compact, wings upright; thread is a thin line rather than a wide healing cone.
Tall narrow chest and close folded wings; sound chevrons have a short lifetime and no lateral screen wash.
